You review at `TIER_DEFAULT`. Render ONE `## Contract review` record on this head — its shape is
`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template --face declaration` — with a PASS or FAIL verdict, and post it as ONE comment
on the PR or its card.

Inputs — these and nothing else:
  · card #35417: its body and EVERY comment (rulings and earlier records included)
  · PR #36013: its body, its file list, and the net diff against `main` at `ada1305cca00be9a188c5d52f7f8d394e092b995`
  · the check-runs on `ada1305cca00be9a188c5d52f7f8d394e092b995`: their conclusions ARE the gate verdicts
⛔ Not the dispatch order, ⛔ not the dispatching seat's own conclusions — this brief is adversarial by design.

⛔ READ-ONLY. No worktree, no checkout, no build, no test run, no gate re-run, no ablation: the check-runs
   on the head already answered every derived gate family, and a local run costs more than it returns.
   If ONE probe is unavoidable, the record's `Local-runs:` line says `probe — REASON`; otherwise `none`.
   Scratch space is `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/3d3cbaf6-4903-5fed-92d4-c2b94a45e868/scratchpad/pr-36013/` alone; nothing there you did not write this round is read.

Judge, in the record's own sections:
  ① Derived judgments — every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each named right or wrong.
  ② Semver level — the changeset (or `skip-changeset`) matches what the diff publishes, and the `Clause-②:` line.
  ③ Boundary flags — every dev flag and every `open_questions` entry answered, or escalated.
     On every face, SQL push-down: a new id materialisation or in-app join where SQL could push down is a
     finding unless a reason is given (AGENTS.md, Prime Directive 5: SQL first).

thing after each colon.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: ada1305cca00be9a188c5d52f7f8d394e092b995 · read 2026-11-21T07:04Z

### 维护者速读

- 可以合：首页顶部的「完成初始设置」清单有三处变化。
  - 「显示已完成」的数字和上面的进度对得上了：有可选项完成时，会分开写成「必做 6 · 可选 2」。
  - 文案里的英文「Setup」换成了各语言里系统设置应用的名字，例如中文是「系统设置」。
  - 只剩一两项没做时，清单收成一行，每项一个「设置」按钮。点语言、时区或货币的「设置」会展开整张卡并打开编辑框，关掉后又收回一行。
- 进度计算、完成规则和保存的设置都没有变。手机上的清单照旧。只改显示，可以直接撤回。

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

None.

### Nits (optional)

- N1: in the one-line form every row's button reads 「设置」 / "Set", and nothing ties it to its row for a screen reader. With two rows, an assistive-tech user hears "Set, Set". An `aria-label` such as `${t('…set')} — ${title}`, or `aria-describedby` pointing at the title span, would name each one.
- N2: the "names the Setup app by its own label" pin checks each pack's text against a list in the test. It does not read the Setup app's label from `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*`. If that label is renamed, the checklist copy can drift and the pin stays green. Optional; this is a cross-package read.

### Checked

- l1-face at `ada1305c`: clean. Checks: 47 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed, mergeable clean. Changeset entries for `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n`. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` for the one added key, with nothing removed. The seat runs the declaration L2.
- ① `checklistDoneCount` splits the done rows with the same `optionalRow` predicate `checklistCompletion` uses, so `required` equals the progress line's `done` by construction. The progress line itself is untouched (ruling #32643 stands). The control shows `showDoneSplit` only when an optional row is done, and otherwise `showDone` with the required count, which reads as before. Pinned managed and self-hosted, plus the pure function.
- ② Setup label: each pack's new wording matches the `setup` app label in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*`. I checked zh-CN 系统设置, zh-Hant 系統設定, ja セットアップ, es Configuración, fr Configuration, ko 설정, ru Настройка, pt-BR Configuração, ar الإعداد and de Setup. en and de keep "Setup". All three strings are changed in each pack: description, `aiProvider.doneSettings` and `connectAssistant.todo`.
- ③ One line:
  - The branch is `!foldable && editing === null && drawsOneLine(drawn)`, so it applies only in the `top` placement, and an open editor always gets the full card. Closing the editor returns to one line.
  - `drawsOneLine` counts the rows left to do, optional ones included, at most 2 and never 0. A completed checklist still returns `null` first.
  - Each `set` matches the full row's own action target: the organization record, the mail and AI settings, users, the assistant path, and the first own app. Localization rows use `{ edit }`. `first_app` has no action in the full card either, so it shows no button.
  - The dismiss button is shared by both forms with the same test id.
  - Pins: one row, two rows, the three-row control, the phone control, the editor round trip, and zh.
- Locales: `showDoneSplit` has real text in all 11 packs (read in en, de, ja and zh-Hans). zh-Hant is regenerated; its text matches the label above.

### Owed

- L1 final on this green head. L2 (declaration, TIER_DEFAULT) is the seat's; this L1 does not replace it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `ada1305cca00be9a188c5d52f7f8d394e092b995`
Local-runs: none

Declaration face, owed by the claim amendment's `Clause-②: yes` line. Inputs: card #35417 (body and all 4 comments: triage, claim, os-dev-report, claim amendment), the PR #36013 body and its 16-file list, the net diff `origin/main...ada1305c` (merge-base `549c9f5b`, 2 commits), and the check-runs on the head: 47 success, 15 skipped, 0 failure, 0 pending. `Check Changeset`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` (16/16 shards), `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and both `PR-body guards` runs are green. The skipped runs are the opt-in, push-only or path-filtered jobs (Test Core shards, Build Core, Dogfood Verify CLI, UI Published Artifacts, Temporal Conformance, and similar), none of them a family this diff derives. The second commit (`ada1305c`) changes one changeset line, `Clause-②: no` to the widening arm, so the dev's test evidence at `d173c3c3` covers the same code.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/i18n` public surface: one key added, right.** `console.firstRunChecklist.showDoneSplit` is added to all eleven packs: ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans and zh-Hant. Because `TranslationKeys = typeof en` is exported from `i18n.ts` and `index.ts`, the exported type gains one member. Nothing is removed or renamed. `createI18n`'s `resources` is typed as an untyped string-keyed record of records (unknown values), so no consumer pack has to supply the new key, and the change is a pure widening. That matches the repo's earlier changesets that grew `TranslationKeys` in the same way. Every pack interpolates both placeholders, `{{required}}` and `{{optional}}`.
- **Existing key values: copy only, right.** Three values change in nine packs (`description`, `aiProvider.doneSettings`, `connectAssistant.todo`). These are value changes, not key changes, so the surface does not move. I checked each replacement against the Setup app label in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.ts` on `main`: zh-CN 系统设置, zh-Hant 系統設定, ja-JP セットアップ, ko 설정, es-ES Configuración, pt-BR Configuração, fr Configuration, ru Настройка, ar الإعداد. All nine match, and de and en are `Setup`, which is why their copy stays unchanged. A test pins this, including a roster assertion that every pack is covered.
- **`@object-ui/console`: internal exports only, right.** `checklistDoneCount`, `ChecklistDoneCount`, `drawsOneLine` and `ONE_LINE_ROWS_LEFT` are new exports of the app-internal `firstRunChecklistLogic.ts`. `ChecklistDrawnRow` is module-local. The component's props (`placement`) are unchanged. The counting rule is consistent: `checklistDoneCount` and `checklistCompletion` take the same `optionalRow` predicate, so `required` always equals the progress line's `done`, and a logic test pins that equality. The progress line stays required-only, as the #32643 ruling the claim cites requires.
- **Accept set: none.** The diff adds no metadata key, accepted value, route, query or stored write. The one-line form only re-renders rows the component already computes. Localization Set calls `setEditing`, the same editor and write path as before, and every other Set is a `Link` to the `to` its full-card row already used (the organization path is reused through `organizationPath`). `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.
- **Card scope: all three asks met, the not-do held.** Item 1: the counts agree. Item 2: no English Setup is left in the non-en/de packs. Item 3: above the page, with 2 or fewer rows left (`drawsOneLine`, optional rows counted), the card draws one line with the title, progress, each remaining row with its Set button, and close. The phone placement (`afterApps`) keeps its own fold, and a control test pins that. The row list is unchanged ("不改清单有哪些项").

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/35417-first-run-checklist-one-line.md` sets `@object-ui/console: patch` and `@object-ui/i18n: patch`. Both packages are moved by the diff, and neither is marked private. Under the level rule (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist item 3 and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` "The LEVEL axis", re-ruled 2026-10-21 on #25105), the level follows `Metadata-protocol` alone. `none` grades `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. Both patch entries are therefore correct. `Check Changeset` is green on this head.
- **Clause-②: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is correct.** The PR body and the changeset body each carry it as a line-initial declaration, with the arm and the key it names (`console.firstRunChecklist.showDoneSplit`; nothing removed). It sits beside `Metadata-protocol: none` in both places. The claim's original `Clause-②: no` was superseded by the claim amendment of 2026-11-21T06:43Z, and the changeset line was corrected to match in `ada1305c`, so the three carriers agree. No `(narrowing)` arm, BREAKING banner, migration or ADR-0087 marker is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- os-dev-report: `open_questions: []`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`, `security_findings: none`. Nothing is left to answer.
- Dev flags in the PR body's Acceptance notes:
  - **Every one-line row uses the shared `set` label: accepted.** This is what the card asks for ("项名 + 「设置」按钮"). The full card keeps each row's own action label.
  - **The Optional mark is drawn on the one-line row: accepted.** It keeps the line from presenting an optional row as required.
  - **The one-line state is derived, not stored: accepted.** No new persistent state is added.
  - **No before/after screenshot: noted, not blocking.** The card's acceptance runs on the hosted environment after deploy ("剩 1 项时卡片高度不超过一行"). Before merge, the DOM shape is pinned instead: no description, no done rows and no toggle. Height on the hosted environment remains a post-deploy check, because `flex-wrap` lets the line wrap at narrow widths by design.
- **Nit, no effect on the contract.** On a profile that adds `first_app`, that row has no `set`, so the one-line form shows its title with no Set button and no detail text. The full card also gives it no action, so behavior is consistent, but the one-line form drops the `todo` hint that the full card shows. This is worth a follow-up only if it turns out to read as a dead row.
- **SQL push-down: no finding.** The diff adds no data access, no id materialisation and no in-app join. The one-line form filters the already-computed `drawn` array in memory, and both new logic functions are pure counts over rows that are already loaded.
- **Process note.** This brief first reached the reviewer as an unexpanded placeholder. On the coordinator's correction, the review followed the seat-written `brief-agent.md` in this round's scratch folder. Its contents match the brief posted beside this record.
